description: Source code for NotifyComponent API handling, including notification registration, message queue processing, and parameter management.

methods.name: NotifyComponent_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Stub function returning TRUE for getting ULONG parameter value.

methods.name: NotifyComponent_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Stub function returning TRUE for setting ULONG parameter value.

methods.name: NotifyComponent_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Handles setting string parameters, posts messages to queue, and updates notification parameters.

methods.name: NotifyComponent_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Stub function returning TRUE for getting string parameter value.

methods.name: NotifyComponent_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Stub function returning TRUE for getting boolean parameter value.

methods.name: NotifyComponent_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Stub function returning TRUE for setting boolean parameter value.

methods.name: NotifyParam
methods.description: Sets or clears notification for a parameter based on 'add' value.

methods.name: AddNotifyParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the notification list, either static array or linked list, and updates the cache file.

methods.name: DelNotifyParam
methods.description: Removes a parameter from the notification list and updates the cache file.

methods.name: Find_Param
methods.description: Finds parameters matching a name and triggers notifications.

methods.name: Notify_To_PAs
methods.description: Sends notifications to registered PAs based on bitmask, including WebPA, TR069, WiFi, Mesh, etc.

methods.name: PA_to_Mask
methods.description: Converts PA name to corresponding bitmask value.

methods.name: UpdateNotifyParamFile
methods.description: Writes current notification parameters to a cache file.

methods.name: ReloadNotifyParam
methods.description: Loads notification parameters from cache file on restart.

methods.name: MsgPosttoQueue
methods.description: Posts message string to message queue.

methods.name: Event_HandlerThread
methods.description: Thread function that receives messages from queue and processes notifications.
